title: Ransone's college UFO sighting in the Eyes on Cinema video

tellings.quote: in the video, she tells this crazy story about how she had a UFO experience when she was a a kid in college and her friend saw it.
And up at Northern Illinois University, 1971 October, it's around 11:00 a.m. and I noticed a strange object above the student union building.
tellings.difference: Dates it to October 1971, around 11 a.m., above the Northern Illinois University student union, where the story puts it in the 1960s and mentions a friend who also saw it.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of Valerie Ransone's own UFO sighting while she was a college student in northern Illinois.

as_told.title: Valerie Ransone's sighting over the Northern Illinois University student union

plain: This story is about Valerie Ransone, who tells of seeing a UFO when she was young, in a video interview on a YouTube channel called Eyes on Cinema. An unnamed researcher, speaking on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, says that in the video she describes a strange experience from her college years, and that a friend of hers saw it too. The story places it in the 1960s in northern Illinois. The host, Jesse Michels, tells it again on a later episode, reading her account. In his version it happened at Northern Illinois University in October 1971, at about 11 in the morning, when she noticed a strange object above the student union building. So the two tellings differ on the date. It is told because, if true, it would add one more ordinary person's sighting to the record, backed by a second witness.
